description: Where to go for a job, before you spend tokens on trial and error: the best tested free official source with its exact call and how much it returns (and a fallback). Ask in plain words, e.g. 'UK company directors', 'Apple revenue', 'EU gas storage'. detail=full adds the paid sellers we rate and other sources.

country.description: optional ISO 3166 two-letter country code to prefer sources for that country, e.g. GB, US, DE

detail.description: full = also the paid sellers, registry-listed sources and other sources (a strong match otherwise returns the route alone)

q.description: what you need, in plain words
